brief.aim: Y1 (heating load) and Y2 (cooling load) are two numeric energy measurements recorded together for each of 768 simulated building configurations, with X1-X8 as design/geometry inputs, so joint multioutput regression on both loads matches the table's evident purpose.
brief.repeated_subjects: Configurations repeat across the 12/7/4/2/4/4/6-level feature grid; each row is a distinct configuration, no repeated unit identifier is present.
brief.unit: simulated building configuration (one row = one building shell/glazing configuration)
